data.completion_memo: Implemented the platform-neutral application generation watchdog and hermetic process adapter. Cleanup is cooperative then forced and must prove the exact tree empty; launches are verification-only with fresh nonce, immutable slot/selector and prior-cleanup preconditions, exact generation handshake, independent health, and complete plan-bound focused verification evidence. Every post-spawn failure is rollback-biased and cleaned before return.
data.description: Implement exact-identity candidate/rollback launch policy over the helper's PlatformProcessPort, startup/health/focused-verification deadlines, authenticated generation handshakes, cleanup ordering, detached-helper survival, stable-launcher ManualRecoveryNotice behavior, and a hermetic process adapter. Readiness is not verification and ambiguous proof is rollback-biased. Native process/IPC implementations are owned by M12.2.
data.title: M11.5 — Implement platform-neutral generation launch and watchdog policy
